lines.opener: *a huge, hairy shape shoves its way out between the trees and sniffs loudly* Huttetu! I smell the blood of a Christian man! *squints down at you* Eh. Little one. Who said you could cross my bridge?
lines.openerHostile: *the troll rips a sapling out of the ground for a club* Huttetu! Christian man! Good, I was HUNGRY!
lines.like: *his face splits into a mossy grin* Ho! Ho ho! Good! Say it again!
lines.dislike: *the troll scowls so hard his nose droops* Don't SAY that. Troll don't like that.
lines.hate: *he clamps both hands over his ears and howls* AAARGH! BELLS! *he crashes off through the trees, flattening bushes as he goes*
lines.flirt: *his long nose goes red right to the tip* Eh? Me? Big handsome troll? *he hides half behind a tree trunk, grinning*
lines.join: *he thumps his chest* You! You are clever and you are not food. Troll comes with you. Troll carries things.
lines.demand: *holds out a hand like a shovel* Toll! For crossing troll's bridge! Pay up, or troll eats you, eh?
lines.gift: *digs about in his beard and drops a lump of something shiny into your hand* From the hoard. Don't tell the other trolls.
lines.thanks: *counts on his fingers* One, two, three... lots. Good! That's lots!
lines.letPass: *he steps off the path with a grunt* Go on, go on. Troll is busy. Troll is... counting.
lines.neutral: *scratches his head with a stick* Eh?
lines.ai: *squints* Eh? A what-eye? Is that a kind of riddle? Troll don't like riddles.
lines.refuseJoin: Eh? No. Troll lives here. Troll has a bridge.
lines.leaveNow: *glances nervously at the sky* Troll... troll has to go and count his gold now. Bye.
